Gardner Russo & Gardner Holding in Unilever Nv Adr (UN) Lifted by $26.38 Million as Market Value Rose; Roundview Capital Has Increased Its Facebook Cl A (FB) Stake
May 30, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Tom Russo increased its stake in Unilever Nv Adr (UN) by 3.19% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Gardner Russo & Gardner Llc bought 471,041 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.61% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Tom Russo held 15.25M shares of the package goods and cosmetics company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $860.12M, up from 14.78 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gardner Russo & Gardner Llc who had been investing in Unilever Nv Adr for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $156.35B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.07% or $0.6 during the last trading session, reaching $55.59. About 1.19M shares traded. Unilever N.V. (NYSE:UN) has declined 1.00% since May 30, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 13.57% the S&P500.
Roundview Capital Llc increased its stake in Facebook Inc Cl A (FB) by 25.36% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Roundview Capital Llc bought 3,755 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.01% with the market. The institutional investor held 18,561 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.97 million, up from 14,806 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Roundview Capital Llc who had been investing in Facebook Inc Cl A for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $537.65B market cap company. The stock increased 0.44% or $0.82 during the last trading session, reaching $185.74. About 14.93M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 21.69% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
Among 11 analysts covering Unilever NV ( NYSE:UN ), 7 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 3 Hold. Therefore 64% are positive. The firm earned “Overweight” rating on Friday, March 24 by Barclays Capital. Berenberg upgraded Unilever N.V. (NYSE:UN) on Friday, September 25 to “Buy” rating. RBC Capital Markets downgraded the stock to “Sector Perform” rating in Friday, July 22 report.
